admission.justification: Realized across tags_engine.py (widened_span, extract_tag_entries) and language_set.py (TreeSitterLanguageProvider policy hashing and forwarding), and guarded by table-driven pilot, long-tail, pure-move, and ambiguous-override tests.

applicability: Declarative tags.scm extraction, parent and leading sibling wrapper widening, pure-move symbol anchoring across code_anchors/read_anchors/currentness/citation_fix, and ambiguous-suffix handling across all admitted catalog languages.
conditions: widened_span extends definition spans across both parent wrappers and contiguous preceding named sibling leading_wrappers while keeping declaration on the construct's own first line.

Every admitted pilot and language-pack language binds expected constructs with zero false definitions on imports, calls, literal keys, strings, comments, or field accesses, and preserves symbol content identity across pure moves.
Ambiguous extensions (.h, .m, .v, .scm) stay occurrence-only by default and resolve cleanly with pure-move agreement once mapped in languages.json.
exclusions: JS/TS test-case .skip/.todo/.each/.for policy remains scoped to JavaScript and TypeScript test files under INV-5FFC2H and INV-B37MWR.

evidence: mcp/.venv/bin/pytest -q mcp/tests/test_multi_language_catalog_soundness.py (clean freeze tree 5da96f042d7c8ef8a3fad843a83038b1fe9aa4ca; 9837/9910 total collected tests within 10000 unit budget)

statement: Every admitted core pilot and language-pack language passes table-driven positive binding accuracy (including wrappers and leading sibling attributes), negative soundness (zero false definitions on imports, calls, literal keys, strings, comments, and field accesses), and pure-move round-trip agreement across code_anchors, read_anchors, currentness, and citation_fix, while ambiguous extensions default to occurrence-only until mapped in languages.json.
title: Admitted languages pass soundness, wrapper, pure-move, and override proofs
